visualReview.method: Each actual saved image individually opened using view_image after all automated assertions passed.
visualReview.result: All six reference pages readable in desktop and actual paused mobile native-fullscreen: full original titles and complete credits, no quotations/URLs/dates/instructions, no reference subtitles. Two preserved Java excerpt cards viewed separately; full old body identity retains their original complete pages.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the five changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
scope: Five batch-12 first appendices after complete original bodies with two retained Java cards; derived pages, title/credit-only cards, 5 desktop 1x endings and 5 native mobile fullscreen cases. No prior-batch media or old appendix proof.
